penalties.details: The Court ordered a fine of Rs 1000/- under section 30(2)(i) of Minimum Wages Act, and a fine of Rs 1000/- under section 28 of Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 observed during a routine labour department inspection.
penalties.impact: The fine of Rs. 2,000 imposed by the Court for minor procedural variances has been remitted, and the matter stands settled with no material financial impact.

penalties.authority: Deputy Controller (Enforcement), Legal Metrology Department, Jammu & Kashmir
penalties.details: The Department of Legal Metrology imposed a fine on a product manufactured by a third-party vendor in furtherance of a seizure memo dated 17.02.2026. The said Fine was on account of violation of S.36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
penalties.impact: The matter has been compounded departmentally, and the proceedings stand closed with no further liability or operational impact.

penalties.authority: Senior Inspector, Legal Metrology, Prayagraj, U.P.
penalties.details: The Controller of Legal Metrology Departmental imposed a fine on multiple third-party products being retailed at the company store observing violation of labelling rules as per the legal metrology act and rules.
penalties.impact: The matter has been compounded departmentally, and the proceedings stand closed with no further liability or operational impact.

penalties.authority: State Tax Department, Hyderabad, Telangana
penalties.details: Assessment for Financial Years 2021-22 to 2023-24 has been initiated by the GST authority u/s 65 and final order was issued to discharge the liability.
penalties.impact: There was an additional observation given by the department after closure of the audit. Hence, an additional liability of Rs. 2,71,682 was levied on the company. The Company has paid the requisite amount and the matter has been resolved in Q2'27.

penalties.authority: GST authorities, Bangalore (Karnataka)
penalties.details: Assessment for Financial Years 2023-24 has been initiated by the GST authority u/s 65 and final order was issued to discharge the liability.
penalties.impact: Liability of Rs. 61,872/- discharged and matter has been resolved.

penalties.authority: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (First), Agra
penalties.details: The Commission passed five separate orders in consumer complaints directing the Company to refund the contested packaging charges (Rs 6 per complaint, with interest), along with compensation and litigation costs aggregating to Rs.15,000 per complaint.
penalties.impact: The financial impact is Rs. 15,006/- per complaint i.e. an overall financial impact of Rs.75,030/- (plus nominal interest) across all five matters. There is no material impact on the financials, operations, or other activities of the Company. The Company is currently assessing the impugned orders for further legal action.

penalties.authority: Assistant Controller, Legal Metrology Department, District Anantnag
penalties.details: The Controller of Legal Metrology Departmental imposed a composite fee of Rs. 1,75,000/- on the Company observing a violation of labelling requirement in packaged garment products.
penalties.impact: The financial impact is limited to the composition fee of Rs. 1,75,000/-, which has been remitted to close the matter. There is no material impact on the financials, operations, or other activities of the Company.
